entries.value: "Runtime-attestation store (SQLite) for base-studio-code — what ACTUALLY served each module while the app ran. The graph ships ~930 modules as records; this is the only place that can say whether a given record served, was declined and fell back to the platform module, or never ran at all."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# Tauri-free core lib + the `bsc runtime` subcommand, so the app (writer) and the umbrella binary
# (reader, and doctor's source) share one implementation. Mirrors bsc-request/plandb/errordb.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# `bundled` compiles SQLite from source (matches src-tauri) for cross-platform reliability.
# Shared SQLite open + busy_timeout plumbing — the app writes while a session reads, so a CLI read
# must never race the app's flush.
# Shared CLI scaffold: the CmdDoc help system + emit().
